title: Coney North Subdistrict
previewText: The regulations of this Section shall apply to all buildings or other structures in the Coney North Subdistrict. Maps 4 (Street Wall Location) and 5 (Minimum and Maximum Base Heights), in the Appendix to this Chapter, illustrate the street wall location provisions, minimum and maximum base height provisions and maximum building height provisions of this Section, inclusive.
